versos.grego: Ταῦτα εἰπὼν Ἰησοῦς ἐξῆλθεν σὺν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ πέραν τοῦ χειμάρρου τῶν Κέδρων, ὅπου ἦν κῆπος, εἰς ὃν εἰσῆλθεν αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.
controles.kjv: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.
controles.livre: Havendo Jesus dito estas coisas, saiu com seus discípulos para além do ribeiro de Cedrom, onde havia um jardim, em que ele entrou ele, e seus discípulos.

versos.grego: ᾔδει δὲ καὶ Ἰούδας ὁ παραδιδοὺς αὐτὸν τὸν τόπον, ὅτι πολλάκις συνήχθη Ἰησοῦς ἐκεῖ μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.
controles.kjv: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.
controles.livre: E também Judas, o que o traía, conhecia aquele lugar; porque muitas vezes se juntara ali Jesus com seus discípulos.

versos.grego: ὁ οὖν Ἰούδας λαβὼν τὴν σπεῖραν καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀρχιερέων καὶ ἐκ τῶν Φαρισαίων ὑπηρέτας ἔρχεται ἐκεῖ μετὰ φανῶν καὶ λαμπάδων καὶ ὅπλων.

controles.web: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.
controles.kjv: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
controles.livre: Tendo Judas, pois, tomado a tropa e alguns dos oficiais dos sacerdotes e dos fariseus, veio ali com lanternas, tochas, e armas.

versos.grego: Ἰησοῦς οὖν εἰδὼς πάντα τὰ ἐρχόμενα ἐπ’ αὐτὸν ἐξῆλθεν καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Τίνα ζητεῖτε;

controles.web: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went out, and said to them, “Who are you looking for?”
controles.kjv: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?
controles.livre: Sabendo pois Jesus todas as coisas que viriam sobre ele, adiantou-se, e disse-lhes: A quem buscais?

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ Ἰησοῦν τὸν Ναζωραῖον. λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἐγώ εἰμι. εἱστήκει δὲ καὶ Ἰούδας ὁ παραδιδοὺς αὐτὸν μετ’ αὐτῶν.

controles.web: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.”   Jesus said to them, “I am he.”   Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.
controles.kjv: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.
controles.livre: Responderam-lhe: A Jesus Nazareno. Disse-lhes Jesus: Eu sou. E Judas, o que o traía, também estava com eles.

versos.grego: ὡς οὖν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἐγώ εἰμι, ἀπῆλθαν εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω καὶ ἔπεσαν χαμαί.

controles.web: When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward, and fell to the ground.
controles.kjv: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
controles.livre: Quando pois lhes disse: Eu sou, voltaram para trás, e caíram em terra.

versos.grego: πάλιν οὖν ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτούς Τίνα ζητεῖτε; οἱ δὲ εἶπαν Ἰησοῦν τὸν Ναζωραῖον.

controles.web: Again therefore he asked them, “Who are you looking for?”   They said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”
controles.kjv: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.
controles.livre: Voltou pois a lhes perguntar: A quem buscais? E eles disseram: A Jesus Nazareno.

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς Εἶπον ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι· εἰ οὖν ἐμὲ ζητεῖτε, ἄφετε τούτους ὑπάγειν·

controles.web: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”
controles.kjv: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:
controles.livre: Respondeu Jesus: Já vos disse que eu sou. Portanto se buscais a mim, deixai a estes irem.

versos.grego: ἵνα πληρωθῇ ὁ λόγος ὃν εἶπεν, ὅτι Οὓς δέδωκάς μοι, οὐκ ἀπώλεσα ἐξ αὐτῶν οὐδένα.

controles.web: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”
controles.kjv: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.
controles.livre: Para que se cumprisse a palavra, que tinha dito: Dos que me deste, a nenhum deles perdi.

versos.grego: Σίμων οὖν Πέτρος ἔχων μάχαιραν εἵλκυσεν αὐτὴν καὶ ἔπαισεν τὸν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως δοῦλον καὶ ἀπέκοψεν αὐτοῦ τὸ ὠτάριον τὸ δεξιόν. ἦν δὲ ὄνομα τῷ δούλῳ Μάλχος.

controles.web: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, and struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
controles.kjv: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
controles.livre: Simão Pedro, pois, que tinha espada, puxou dela, e feriu ao servo do sacerdote, e cortou a sua orelha direita. E era o nome do servo Malco.

versos.grego: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τῷ Πέτρῳ Βάλε τὴν μάχαιραν εἰς τὴν θήκην· τὸ ποτήριον ὃ δέδωκέν μοι ὁ Πατήρ, οὐ μὴ πίω αὐτό;

controles.web: Jesus therefore said to Peter, “Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?”
controles.kjv: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?
controles.livre: Disse pois Jesus a Pedro: Põe tua espada na bainha; não beberei eu o copo que o Pai tem me dado?

versos.grego: Ἡ οὖν σπεῖρα καὶ ὁ χιλίαρχος καὶ οἱ ὑπηρέται τῶν Ἰουδαίων συνέλαβον τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ ἔδησαν αὐτὸν,

controles.web: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews, seized Jesus and bound him,
controles.kjv: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,
controles.livre: O grupo de soldados pois, e o comandante, e os oficiais dos judeus juntamente tomaram a Jesus, e o amarraram.

versos.grego: καὶ ἤγαγον πρὸς Ἅνναν πρῶτον· ἦν γὰρ πενθερὸς τοῦ Καϊάφα, ὃς ἦν ἀρχιερεὺς τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ ἐκείνου·

controles.web: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.
controles.kjv: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.
controles.livre: E o levaram primeiramente a Anás, porque era sogro de Caifás, o qual era o sumo sacerdote daquele ano.

versos.grego: ἦν δὲ Καϊάφας ὁ συμβουλεύσας τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ὅτι συμφέρει ἕνα ἄνθρωπον ἀποθανεῖν ὑπὲρ τοῦ λαοῦ.

controles.web: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.
controles.kjv: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
controles.livre: E era Caifás o que havia aconselhado aos judeus de que convinha que um homem morresse pelo povo.

versos.grego: Ἠκολούθει δὲ τῷ Ἰησοῦ Σίμων Πέτρος καὶ ἄλλος μαθητής. ὁ δὲ μαθητὴς ἐκεῖνος ἦν γνωστὸς τῷ ἀρχιερεῖ, καὶ συνεισῆλθεν τῷ Ἰησοῦ εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως,

controles.web: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;
controles.kjv: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.
controles.livre: E Simão Pedro seguia a Jesus com outro discípulo. E este discípulo era conhecido do sacerdote, e entrou com Jesus no pátio do sumo sacerdote.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος εἱστήκει πρὸς τῇ θύρᾳ ἔξω. ἐξῆλθεν οὖν ὁ μαθητὴς ὁ ἄλλος ὁ γνωστὸς τοῦ ἀρχιερέως καὶ εἶπεν τῇ θυρωρῷ, καὶ εἰσήγαγεν τὸν Πέτρον.

controles.web: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.
controles.kjv: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.
controles.livre: E Pedro estava fora à porta. Saiu pois o outro discípulo, que era conhecido do sacerdote, e falou à porteira, e pôs dentro a Pedro.

versos.grego: λέγει οὖν τῷ Πέτρῳ ἡ παιδίσκη ἡ θυρωρός Μὴ καὶ σὺ ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν εἶ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τούτου; λέγει ἐκεῖνος Οὐκ εἰμί.

controles.web: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?”   He said, “I am not.”
controles.kjv: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man’s disciples? He saith, I am not.
controles.livre: Disse pois a serva porteira a Pedro: Não és tu também dos discípulos deste homem? Disse ele: Não sou.

versos.grego: εἱστήκεισαν δὲ οἱ δοῦλοι καὶ οἱ ὑπηρέται ἀνθρακιὰν πεποιηκότες, ὅτι ψῦχος ἦν, καὶ ἐθερμαίνοντο· ἦν δὲ καὶ ὁ Πέτρος μετ’ αὐτῶν ἑστὼς καὶ θερμαινόμενος.

controles.web: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.
controles.kjv: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.
controles.livre: E estavam ali os servos, e os oficiais, que haviam feito uma fogueira de brasas, porque fazia frio, e se esquentavam. Estava Pedro com eles, e se esquentava.

versos.grego: Ὁ οὖν ἀρχιερεὺς ἠρώτησεν τὸν Ἰησοῦν περὶ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ περὶ τῆς διδαχῆς αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples, and about his teaching.
controles.kjv: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.
controles.livre: Perguntou pois o sacerdote a Jesus sobre seus discípulos, e sobre sua doutrina.

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Ἰησοῦς Ἐγὼ παρρησίᾳ λελάληκα τῷ κόσμῳ· ἐγὼ πάντοτε ἐδίδαξα ἐν συναγωγῇ καὶ ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ, ὅπου πάντες οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι συνέρχονται, καὶ ἐν κρυπτῷ ἐλάλησα οὐδέν.

controles.web: Jesus answered him, “I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues, and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.
controles.kjv: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.
controles.livre: Jesus lhe respondeu: Eu abertamente falei ao mundo; eu sempre ensinei na sinagoga e no Templo, onde os Judeus de todos os lugares se juntam, e nada falei em oculto.

versos.grego: τί με ἐρωτᾷς; ἐρώτησον τοὺς ἀκηκοότας τί ἐλάλησα αὐτοῖς· ἴδε οὗτοι οἴδασιν ἃ εἶπον ἐγώ.

controles.web: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, these know the things which I said.”
controles.kjv: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.
controles.livre: Por que perguntas a mim? Pergunta aos que o ouviram, que é o que lhes falei. Eis que estes sabem que é o que tenho dito.

versos.grego: ταῦτα δὲ αὐτοῦ εἰπόντος εἷς παρεστηκὼς τῶν ὑπηρετῶν ἔδωκεν ῥάπισμα τῷ Ἰησοῦ εἰπών Οὕτως ἀποκρίνῃ τῷ ἀρχιερεῖ;

controles.web: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high priest like that?”
controles.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?
controles.livre: E dizendo ele isto, um dos oficiais, que ali estava, deu a Jesus uma bofetada, dizendo: Assim respondes ao sumo sacerdote?

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Ἰησοῦς Εἰ κακῶς ἐλάλησα, μαρτύρησον περὶ τοῦ κακοῦ· εἰ δὲ καλῶς, τί με δέρεις;

controles.web: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?”
controles.kjv: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?
controles.livre: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Se falei mal, dá testemunho do mal; e se bem, por que me feres?

versos.grego: ἀπέστειλεν οὖν αὐτὸν ὁ Ἄννας δεδεμένον πρὸς Καϊάφαν τὸν ἀρχιερέα.

controles.web: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.
controles.kjv: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.
controles.livre: (Pois Anás o mandara amarrado ao sumo sacerdote Caifás.)

versos.grego: Ἦν δὲ Σίμων Πέτρος ἑστὼς καὶ θερμαινόμενος. εἶπον οὖν αὐτῷ Μὴ καὶ σὺ ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ εἶ; ἠρνήσατο ἐκεῖνος καὶ εἶπεν Οὐκ εἰμί.

controles.web: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples, are you?”   He denied it, and said, “I am not.”
controles.kjv: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.
controles.livre: E Simão Pedro estava ali, e se esquentava; disseram-lhe pois: Não és tu também de seus discípulos? Ele negou, e disse: Não sou.

versos.grego: λέγει εἷς ἐκ τῶν δούλων τοῦ ἀρχιερέως, συγγενὴς ὢν οὗ ἀπέκοψεν Πέτρος τὸ ὠτίον Οὐκ ἐγώ σε εἶδον ἐν τῷ κήπῳ μετ’ αὐτοῦ;

controles.web: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”
controles.kjv: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?
controles.livre: Disse um dos servos do sacerdote, parente daquele a quem Pedro cortara a orelha: Eu não te vi no jardim com ele?

versos.grego: πάλιν οὖν ἠρνήσατο Πέτρος, καὶ εὐθέως ἀλέκτωρ ἐφώνησεν.

controles.web: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.
controles.kjv: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.
controles.livre: Pedro negou pois outra vez, e logo cantou o galo.

versos.grego: Ἄγουσιν οὖν τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἀπὸ τοῦ Καϊάφα εἰς τὸ πραιτώριον· ἦν δὲ πρωΐ· καὶ αὐτοὶ οὐκ εἰσῆλθον εἰς τὸ πραιτώριον, ἵνα μὴ μιανθῶσιν ἀλλὰ φάγωσιν τὸ πάσχα.

controles.web: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.
controles.kjv: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.
controles.livre: Levaram pois a Jesus de Caifás para o tribunal. E era pela manhã; e não entraram no tribunal, para que não se contaminassem, mas que pudessem comer a Páscoa.

versos.grego: ἐξῆλθεν οὖν ὁ Πειλᾶτος ἔξω πρὸς αὐτοὺς καὶ φησίν Τίνα κατηγορίαν φέρετε τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τούτου;

controles.web: Pilate therefore went out to them, and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”
controles.kjv: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?
controles.livre: Saiu pois Pilatos até eles fora, e disse: Que acusação trazeis contra este homem?

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθησαν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Εἰ μὴ ἦν οὗτος κακὸν ποιῶν, οὐκ ἄν σοι παρεδώκαμεν αὐτόν.

controles.web: They answered him, “If this man weren’t an evildoer, we wouldn’t have delivered him up to you.”
controles.kjv: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.
controles.livre: Responderam, e disseram-lhe: Se este não fosse malfeitor, não o entregaríamos a ti.

versos.grego: εἶπεν οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Πειλᾶτος Λάβετε αὐτὸν ὑμεῖς, καὶ κατὰ τὸν νόμον ὑμῶν κρίνατε αὐτόν. εἶπον αὐτῷ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι Ἡμῖν οὐκ ἔξεστιν ἀποκτεῖναι οὐδένα·

controles.web: Pilate therefore said to them, “Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law.”   Therefore the Jews said to him, “It is not lawful for us to put anyone to death,”
controles.kjv: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
controles.livre: Disse-lhes pois Pilatos: Tomai-o vós, e julgai-o segundo vossa lei. Disseram-lhe pois os Judeus: Não nos é lícito matar a alguém.

versos.grego: ἵνα ὁ λόγος τοῦ Ἰησοῦ πληρωθῇ ὃν εἶπεν σημαίνων ποίῳ θανάτῳ ἤμελλεν ἀποθνήσκειν.

controles.web: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
controles.kjv: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.
controles.livre: Para que se cumprisse a palavra de Jesus, que tinha dito, dando a entender de que morte havia de morrer.

versos.grego: Εἰσῆλθεν οὖν πάλιν εἰς τὸ πραιτώριον ὁ Πειλᾶτος καὶ ἐφώνησεν τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Σὺ εἶ ὁ Βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων;

controles.web: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”
controles.kjv: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?
controles.livre: Então Pilatos voltou a entrar no tribunal, e chamou a Jesus, e disse-lhe: És tu o Rei dos Judeus?

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς Ἀφ’ ἑαυτοῦ σὺ τοῦτο λέγεις, ἢ ἄλλοι εἶπόν σοι περὶ ἐμοῦ;

controles.web: Jesus answered him, “Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?”
controles.kjv: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?
controles.livre: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Tu dizes isso de ti mesmo, ou outros te disseram de mim?

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη ὁ Πειλᾶτος Μήτι ἐγὼ Ἰουδαῖός εἰμι; τὸ ἔθνος τὸ σὸν καὶ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς παρέδωκάν σε ἐμοί· τί ἐποίησας;

controles.web: Pilate answered, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?”
controles.kjv: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?
controles.livre: Pilatos respondeu: Por acaso eu sou Judeu? Tua gente e os chefes dos sacerdotes te entregaram a mim; que fizeste?

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς· Ἡ βασιλεία ἡ ἐμὴ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου τούτου· εἰ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου τούτου ἦν ἡ βασιλεία ἡ ἐμή, οἱ ὑπηρέται ἂν οἱ ἐμοὶ ἠγωνίζοντο, ἵνα μὴ παραδοθῶ τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις· νῦν δὲ ἡ βασιλεία ἡ ἐμὴ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐντεῦθεν.

controles.web: Jesus answered, “My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn’t be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.”
controles.kjv: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.
controles.livre: Respondeu Jesus: Meu Reino não é deste mundo; se meu Reino fosse deste mundo, meus trabalhadores lutariam, para que eu não fosse entregue aos Judeus; mas agora meu Reino não é daqui.

versos.grego: εἶπεν οὖν αὐτῷ ὁ Πειλᾶτος Οὐκοῦν βασιλεὺς εἶ σύ; ἀπεκρίθη ὁ Ἰησοῦς Σὺ λέγεις ὅτι βασιλεύς εἰμι. ἐγὼ εἰς τοῦτο γεγέννημαι καὶ εἰς τοῦτο ἐλήλυθα εἰς τὸν κόσμον, ἵνα μαρτυρήσω τῇ ἀληθείᾳ· πᾶς ὁ ὢν ἐκ τῆς ἀληθείας ἀκούει μου τῆς φωνῆς.

controles.web: Pilate therefore said to him, “Are you a king then?”   Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”
controles.kjv: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.
controles.livre: Disse-lhe pois Pilatos: Logo tu és Rei? Respondeu Jesus: Tu dizes que eu sou Rei. Para isto eu nasci, e para isto vim ao mundo: para dar testemunho à verdade. Todo aquele que é da verdade ouve minha voz.

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Πειλᾶτος Τί ἐστιν ἀλήθεια; Καὶ τοῦτο εἰπὼν πάλιν ἐξῆλθεν πρὸς τοὺς Ἰουδαίους, καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἐγὼ οὐδεμίαν εὑρίσκω ἐν αὐτῷ αἰτίαν.

controles.web: Pilate said to him, “What is truth?”   When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, “I find no basis for a charge against him.
controles.kjv: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.
controles.livre: Disse-lhe Pilatos: O que é a verdade? E havendo dito isto, voltou a sair aos Judeus, e disse-lhes: Nenhum crime acho nele.

versos.grego: ἔστιν δὲ συνήθεια ὑμῖν ἵνα ἕνα ἀπολύσω ὑμῖν ἐν τῷ πάσχα· βούλεσθε οὖν ἀπολύσω ὑμῖν τὸν Βασιλέα τῶν Ἰουδαίων;

controles.web: But you have a custom, that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
controles.kjv: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
controles.livre: Mas vós tendes por costume que eu vos solte um pela páscoa. Quereis pois que vos solte ao Rei dos Judeus?

versos.grego: ἐκραύγασαν οὖν πάλιν λέγοντες Μὴ τοῦτον, ἀλλὰ τὸν Βαραββᾶν. ἦν δὲ ὁ Βαραββᾶς λῃστής.

controles.web: Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.
controles.kjv: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
controles.livre: Voltaram pois todos a clamar, dizendo: Não a este, mas a Barrabás!E Barrabás era um ladrão.
